episode_title: Building, Bootstrapping and Selling Wrinkle Schminkles | Gabrielle Requena

real_qa.q: What product innovation did Wrinkle Schminkles pioneer and what material makes it effective?
real_qa.r: Wrinkle Schminkles created a patch range in 2014 targeting lines and wrinkles using medical-grade silicone, which had been used to treat scars on the skin for a long time. The patches are designed to address lines and wrinkles caused by side sleeping, offering a unique alternative to traditional skincare and cosmetic procedures.
real_qa.requete: Wrinkle Schminkles medical grade silicone patches

real_qa.q: How did Wrinkle Schminkles achieve viral growth on TikTok and what was the scale of that moment?
real_qa.r: Wrinkle Schminkles had a major TikTok viral moment in March during COVID when influencer budgets shifted from travel and fashion to beauty and home. The brand had been gaining traction with videos reaching 1 to 10 million views, but their biggest viral video reached approximately 55 million views, creating a chain of fortunate events that allowed them to ride a wave of unprecedented awareness.
real_qa.requete: Wrinkle Schminkles TikTok viral 55 million views

real_qa.q: Why did Wrinkle Schminkles reject investment opportunities and remain bootstrapped until acquisition?
real_qa.r: Gabrielle remained bootstrapped throughout Wrinkle Schminkles' growth, never receiving investment offers from Shark Tank (she was rejected) and choosing not to pursue external funding. She built the business with a patient build mentality, ensuring the business generated profit which was reinvested to grow and scale, and later realized bootstrapping aligned better with her personality when considering either investment or acquisition options.
real_qa.requete: Wrinkle Schminkles bootstrapped no investment acquisition

real_qa.q: How did Wrinkle Schminkles expand to 22 countries and what was the key strategy for international market entry?
real_qa.r: Wrinkle Schminkles sold in over 22 countries with physical warehouses in three major markets: Australia, UK, and US. The expansion strategy leveraged DTC capabilities to test campaigns across markets using SEO organic growth in the US first, then launched into the UK profitably before going to market for acquisition to demonstrate the ability to enter new markets profitably.

real_qa.q: What was the impact of appearing on Shark Tank on Wrinkle Schminkles' sales performance?
real_qa.r: Shark Tank became Wrinkle Schminkles' best-performing marketing campaign even 12 years after the business was sold. Although Gabrielle was nervous, the show spiked sales significantly more than her appearance on Real Housewives of Sydney, and the Shark Tank campaign remained their top-performing meta campaign throughout the company's lifetime, described as 'the gift that kept on giving.'
real_qa.requete: Shark Tank Wrinkle Schminkles best performing campaign

guest.bio_context: Gabrielle started her career in management consulting after studying a Masters of E-Commerce at Bond University. She worked in corporate roles including at eBay before launching her own consulting business as a one-woman operation. She discovered the problem that became Wrinkle Schminkles when noticing fine lines and wrinkles on her own skin caused by side sleeping, leading her to prototype a solution using medical-grade silicone.

real_quote: When you get lucky is just to be so ready to take advantage of that luck because it's hard work sitting underneath waiting for these lucky moments.
key_stats: Wrinkle Schminkles patch range created in 2014
Copycat brand launched 2 years after Wrinkle Schminkles in US market
Viral TikTok video reached approximately 55 million views in March during COVID period
Wrinkle Schminkles sold in over 22 countries with warehouses in 3 markets (Australia, UK, US)
Shark Tank remained the best-performing marketing campaign for 12 years until business was sold
Company turned over approximately $300,000 in 24 hours during planned flash sale appearance
